notes: AWLS-SDST first milestone: make AWLS internal timing and emitted operation records respect sequence-dependent setup gaps.
The worker must reuse harness_agent.standard_fjsp.parse_standard_fjsp and setup_time_between; it must not create a parallel SDST parser.
Only awls_sdst_time_propagation is user-confirmed in this manifest. N7/NK move evaluation and zi policy are later-stage slots.

slots.title: AWLS-SDST setup-aware time propagation
slots.purpose: Update AWLS graph head/tail timing so machine arcs include sequence-dependent setup time when the parsed instance contains setup data.
inputs: self.index: OperationIndex mapping AWLS node ids to job/op ids and candidate durations
invariants: Keep AwlsSchedule.update_time signature and public fields unchanged.
Keep standard FJSP behavior unchanged when instance.has_sequence_dependent_setup is false.
Use setup_time_between from harness_agent.standard_fjsp; do not implement a new SDST parser.
Do not modify evaluator, parser, solution schema, CLI arguments, or benchmark semantics.
Emitted ScheduleRecord start/end times remain processing intervals only; setup intervals are implicit and checked by evaluator.
allowed_edits: Only rewrite code between awls_sdst_time_propagation markers.
May add local helper variables inside the slot.
May call setup_time_between(instance, machine_id, previous_op, current_op, op_index).
May map AWLS node ids to operation keys using self.index.node_to_job and self.index.node_to_op.
forbidden_edits: Do not create helper files for setup parsing.
Do not change OperationIndex.from_instance or parse_standard_fjsp.
Do not touch same-machine/change-machine move generation in this stage.
Do not change zi policy in this stage.
